name: Ace Online
summary: Perth ISP founded Oct 1996; acquired Indigo Networks 2002; acquired by EFTel 17 Jul 2006.

names.name: Ace Online
source: 2007 About page: 'Operating since October 1996'; 2002 homepage footer '© 1996-2001 Ace Online Internet' (Perth): https://web.archive.org/web/20070119010508id_/http://www.aceonline.com.au/about/index.php

events.details: Acquired Indigo Networks: aceonline.com.au page title changed to 'Indigo Networks' from Sept 2002; 2007 About page describes 'the fusion of two local internet/IT companies ... combined the operations, customer base and assets of Indigo Networks and Ace Online'.
Acquired by EFTel (reported 17 Jul 2006, ZDNet). Consistent with the retail site being gone/repurposed by 2008; the exact EFTel date rests on the ZDNet report rather than a located ASX announcement.
